concerns.text: FR-001 assumes that the HCP Subjects Release provides paired resting‑state fMRI data **and** Music Emotion Rating (MER) behavioral scores. Independent verification (e.g., HCP data dictionary) shows that the HCP 1200 Subjects release does **not** include a Music Task or MER scores. Consequently, the validation target (MER scores) is not actually available from the same subjects as the neural data, breaking the required independence between predictor (network metrics) and outcome (MER) and rendering the core hypothesis test (correlation/regression) unsound. The spec must either (a) source MER scores from an external dataset and explicitly describe a reliable subject‑matching procedure, or (b) revise FR-001 to remove the false claim of a paired HCP Music Task subset.
